schedules.commentary:
Stop frustrating your customers with rigid 'Press 1 for Support' trees. 🛑

In 2026, the battle for Customer Experience (CX) is won through Agentic CX Automation. We have officially crossed the chasm from static, script-following chatbots to autonomous multi-agent systems that negotiate, resolve, and personalize in real-time.

By connecting LLM agents directly to secure internal APIs, modern enterprises are resolving complex refunds, billing disputes, and custom setups in seconds—not days.

The result? Lower operational costs, zero-queue wait times, and a highly personalized experience that actually feels human.

Is your CX stack still stuck in the past? Here is how the paradigm has shifted. 👇

#CustomerExperience #AI #Automation #SoftwareEngineering #TechTrends

logs.commentary:
Is 'Clean Code' dead in the age of AI? 🤖

In 2026, we aren't just writing code for humans anymore—we are writing it to be read, refactored, and maintained by LLM co-pilots and autonomous AI agents.

Because of this, the definition of 'Clean Code' has fundamentally shifted. Highly compressed, clever abstractions that humans used to love actually degrade AI code-understanding. Today, 'clean' means predictability, strict typing, and high-context structures.

Here is how clean code practices have transformed for the AI era. 

Are you still using legacy clean code rules, or have you adapted to the hybrid developer workflow? Let's discuss in the comments! 👇

#CleanCode #SoftwareEngineering #AI #DeveloperProductivity #Coding
